variety_description: A high-yielding, late maturity, semi-dwarf, short slender grain variety,  grown extensively in southern & eastern India. Developed by ARS, Bapatla and released in 1989 for rainfed shallow lowland areas. Excellent productive tillering and erect, sturdy stem with good grain quality. Highly popular variety. Ideal genotype for identifying mutational changes and varietal improvements with traits of agronomic importance.
